body:
## What it does

An accountant for one person rather than a company. It follows what comes in against what goes out, keeps the tax position in view, and raises a flag while there is still time to move something before a due date arrives. Payday is treated as the moment to chip away at debt, so more of the cheque survives the month.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @zilarwitch shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
